phrase: a Camel and Goat Milk Brand
verdict: Yes, as a niche brand. Aadvik pitched camel and goat milk products on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Camel milk from Rajasthan and Gujarat has a small, loyal market, but supply is limited and processing is specialised.
angle: Camel and goat milk are bought for health reasons and by people with cow-milk sensitivities. Powders, chocolates and soaps extend shelf life. Working with pastoral communities gives a strong story.
